title: Validate capability scopes at grant time
summary: Reject malformed non-empty scopes for known capability action namespaces before the daemon signs and persists grants.
expectedFailureModes: Malformed scopes are signed into durable capability logs and become hard to distinguish from intentional operator grants.
Future dispatch-time scope enforcement breaks old grants because grant-time validation never established a stable compatibility boundary.
Public documentation overstates least-privilege enforcement if malformed scopes are still accepted by the grant path.
nextAction: Integrated locally; next hardening should add dispatch-time scope predicate checks for the first stable low-risk action family.
